input.quote: 14.3 Liquidated Damages. In the event that Array (a) [ * ] during [ * ], or (b) intentionally conceals or falsifies a material result and/or material item of data concerning the safety or efficacy of the Product, which concealment or falsification (i) is undertaken to induce Ono to not terminate this Agreement and (ii) results in a substantial reduction to the value of the Product in the Ono Territory, then, as an alternative to its right to terminate this Agreement pursuant to Section 13.3 above, Ono may in its discretion elect to continue this Agreement
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty or termination fee payable by Ono, so it meets the preferred position. The only liquidated damages provision, Section 14.3, runs in our favour: on specified Array failures Ono may elect to continue the Agreement, be relieved of its diligence obligations, and take a reduced royalty rate "as liquidated damages" (p0671) — a Vendor-payable remedy that is compliant and must not be redlined. Termination by Ono without cause under Section 13.2 requires only advance notice with no exit fee or minimum payment; Article VI payments are ordinary upfront, milestone and royalty consideration, and the Section 7.1 late-payment interest at Libor is ordinary interest, not a penalty. Section 8.2's post-termination Competing Product standstill is a non-compete restriction, not a Customer-payable liquidated amount, and is addressed under other rules.

mappings.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
mappings.quote: as liquidated damages for the breaches described
